key_facts: The team is designing a new remote control that should be original, trendy, and user-friendly.
The selling price of the remote control is set at 25 Euros.
The target profit for the company is 50 million Euros.
The production cost should not exceed 12.50 Euros.
The remote control should be compact and multi-functional, capable of controlling various household devices such as TVs, air conditioners, and heating systems.
The team discussed adding features like a beep or blinking light to help users locate the remote control when it is lost.
The team considered using a light sensor to detect darkness and trigger a signal.
The marketing team needs to create user requirement specifications focusing on friendliness and justifying the price point with sufficient features.
The project manager mentioned that the industrial designer is responsible for the technical-functional design.
The next meeting is scheduled in thirty minutes.
